title: Universal HUB l Inf Yield l Dark Dex V3 And More
features:
1 Combat Nexus (Aimbot):
Checks logic: Uses WorldToViewportPoint to find enemies.

Features: Radius adjustment, Visibility check (Raycasting via GetPartsObscuringTarget), and Team checks.

Controls: Aims when you hold Right Mouse Button.

Omni-Hub (Cloud Loader):
This section dynamically loads scripts. It includes real, working URLs for:
Infinite Yield (The standard for FE Admin).
Dark Dex (For viewing game explorer).
SimpleSpy (For logging remote events).
Nameless Admin & Unnamed ESP.
Simply clicking a button fetches the code from GitHub and executes it instantly.

Shadow Flight:
Instead of unreliable BodyVelocity physics that might get anti-cheat flagged quickly, this uses CFrame indexing. This forces your character's coordinates to move, acting like a "Noclip" fly.
Controls: WASD to move, Space to go up, Ctrl to go down.

FPS / World Tools:
Added a Texture Deleter for laggy machines.
Fullbright for seeing in dark games.
